Descends from at least one root that wave 4 materially repaired. Alpha read each such repair on final disk text: every one of them either (a) corrected prose ABOUT the mathematics — an ambient-invariance claim, a choice ledger, a reading-order claim, a description of a cited route — leaving every Definition, Statement and numbered step intact; (b) restated a Facts-block entry to say what its cited target actually states, without changing the proposition the step consumes; or (c) added a hypothesis that the item's own Statement already declared (the Axiom of Choice or countable choice) to a title or an explanatory sentence that had omitted it. Case (c) narrows a title and cannot invalidate a consumer; cases (a) and (b) change no exported proposition. The two genuine interface additions are ex-sigma-compactness-and-lindelof-in-the-line-and-the-rationals, which GAINED the dependency thm-countable-union-of-countable and a Fact [L10] for a step that had been under-cited, and ex-one-point-compactifications-of-the-line-and-of-the-naturals, which DROPPED an unused closedness/compactness claim about the circle from step 1.2 while keeping the metrizability its later step uses; neither removes anything a consumer could have taken. still-licensed.
